name: Batocera EmulationStation
description: HTTPS-enforced but fetches and directly executes an unsigned batocera-upgrade shell script from GitHub-raw.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Batocera EmulationStation has platform-specific updater components and a shared networking helper. The retained evidence does not establish the original cross-platform script provenance or full payload-authentication policy.
limitations: The external es-update script and Batocera Linux packaging are outside this repository.

original_evidence.text: | Batocera EmulationStation (batocera-linux fork) | https://github.com/batocera-linux/batocera-emulationstation.git | f839490 / 2026-08-19 | Y | N (menu "START UPDATE", user-initiated) | Y | https, TLS enforced (curl, no `-k`/`--insecure`) | N | **none** | n/a | `es-app/src/ApiSystem.cpp:251-263`: `updateSystem()` runs `curl --connect-timeout 10 -m 30 -L -f -s -o /tmp/batocera-upgrade https://github.com/batocera-linux/batocera.linux/raw/refs/heads/master/package/batocera/core/batocera-scripts/scripts/batocera-upgrade && chmod +x /tmp/batocera-upgrade`, then (`:277`) `popen(upgradeScriptPath + " --upgrade")` — the fetched shell script is executed with **zero hash or signature check** before being chmod+x'd and run. `es-app/src/guis/GuiUpdate.cpp` wires this to the "START UPDATE" menu action in `GuiMenu.cpp:1225`. Whatever the downloaded `batocera-upgrade` script itself later verifies (out of scope of this repo) is irrelevant — GitHub/CDN compromise of that one raw file = RCE |
